book.title: Mak Mak beleŋ Mere igiŋ Yesu niŋ yitiŋ kayyiŋ

content: Yesu Al Kuruŋyen ya balem bana hurkuriŋ

Be, Yesuya komatmiŋ yagoya gobe Yerusalem binde binde hamiŋ. Irdeb Betfage taundeya Betani taundeya gor kwamiŋ. Taun irawa gobe Olip dugu dabayiŋde gor haryen. Be, Yesu beleŋ taun kura hinhinde gor matbe komatmiŋ irawa kura hulyaŋ yirdeb gaha yinyiŋ:
“Taun iroyenter iro kuri. Kuŋbe doŋki foŋeŋ kura al go hende ma kuŋ hitiŋ goyen feŋde hike kiniryeŋ. Keneŋbe hol irde teŋ wayiryeŋ.
Al kura beleŋ, ‘Gob daha teŋ har?’ dinkeb, ‘Doyaŋ Al Kuruŋ beleŋ gake yihi. Niŋgeb heŋ ga moŋ tumulgaŋ tiyyeŋ,’ iniryeŋ,” yinyiŋ.
Niŋgeb kuŋbe Yesu beleŋ yinyiŋ gwahade po doŋki goyen ya siŋakde feŋ titiŋ kenaryum.
Irde kuŋ hol irde hikeb al gor hinhan goreb, “Daha irye yeŋ doŋki go hol irde har?” yinamiŋ.
Irkeb Yesu beleŋ yinyiŋ gwahade po wol hekeb yubul tike teŋ kwaryum.
Be, doŋki go Yesu hitte tawaŋbe uliŋhormiŋ yugu teŋ doŋki go hende ugamkeb go hende hurkuŋ keperde kuriŋ.

Kuŋ hikeb al budam Yesu go palap irniŋ yeŋ uliŋhormiŋ yugu teŋ beleŋyaŋ ugamamiŋ. Irkeb al kurabe Yesu turuŋ irniŋ yeŋ beleŋ umŋa ird ird niŋ patila yuwalŋeŋ walde yawayamiŋ goyen beleŋyaŋ sar irde tukamiŋ.
Al kurab meheŋ hekeb kurab kame heŋbe tumŋaŋ ala deŋem isaŋ heŋ gaha yamiŋ:

content.text: Doyaŋ Al Kuruŋyen deŋemde waŋ hi al gobe Al Kuruŋ beleŋ guram irde tareŋ iryeŋ!
Asininiŋ Dewit beleŋ alya bereyamiŋ doyaŋ yirde hinhin gwahade yara
yeŋ beleŋ doyaŋ diryeŋ gobe Al Kuruŋ beleŋ guram irde saŋiŋ iryeŋ.
Hosanna! Al Kuruŋ, tareŋge kuruŋ wor po!” yamiŋ.

content: Be, Yesu go Yerusalem forok yeŋbe Al Kuruŋyen ya balem bana hurkuriŋ. Irdeb dawet kuruŋ bana goyen yeneŋ tukuriŋ. Gega naŋa hubu hiriŋ geb, komatmiŋ 12ya Betani kwamiŋ.
Yesu Al Kuruŋyen ya balem bana hurkuŋ ya haraŋ hiriŋ
Be, fay urkeb Betani tubul teŋ heŋyabe Yesu go biŋge iryiŋ.

Irkeb fik he yuwalŋeŋ digula urtiŋ goyen keneŋbe igineŋ miŋyaŋ daw yeŋ kuŋ kinyiŋ. Kuŋ miŋde mat naŋkinyiŋ gega, igineŋ miŋmoŋ, yuwalŋeŋ beleŋ po aw urtiŋ kinyiŋ. Fik ferd ferd nalu moŋ geb, igineŋ miŋmoŋ kinyiŋ.
Gwahade keneŋbe Yesu beleŋ he goyen, “Al kura igineŋge sopte ma niyyeŋ,” ineŋ karan uryiŋ. Irkeb mere tiyyiŋ goyen komatmiŋ yago beleŋ nuramiŋ.

Be, kuŋ Yerusalem forok yeŋbe Yesube Al Kuruŋyen ya balem koya beleŋ po milgu irtiŋ bana goŋ hurkuŋ al buda kuruŋ gor det damu teŋ hinhan goyen kwep kwep yirde yakira tiyyiŋ. Irde hora kapyaŋ heŋ heŋ marte
gasuŋ yad yaboloŋ teŋ nu damu teŋ hinhan marte keperd keperd gasuŋ manaŋ yad yaboloŋ teŋ yunyiŋ.
Irdeb, “Damu teŋ teŋde niŋ dawet ya balem diliŋyaŋ goyaŋ gore sopte yukyawaŋ ma yirnayiŋ,” yinyiŋ.

Irdeb saba yirde heŋyabe, “Al Kuruŋyen asaŋdebe, ‘Nere yabe megen niŋ al buda kuruŋ gayen gare waŋ gabu irde mere nird nird ya hiyyeŋ,’ yitiŋ goyen ma nurde haŋyen? Gega deŋbe ya gayen teŋ kawe marte bana kuŋ kuŋ gasuŋ irde haŋ,” yinyiŋ.

Gwaha yinkeb al buda kuruŋ gor gabu iramiŋ mar gore meremiŋ go nurde dinoŋ kok yamiŋ. Niŋgeb goke Al Kuruŋ doloŋ ird ird mata doyaŋ marte karkuwaŋmiŋya pris buda gote karkuwaŋmiŋya Moseyen saba maryabe kafura heŋbe, “Daha mat kura mayteke kamyeŋ?” yeŋ beleŋ niŋ naŋkeneŋ hinhan.
Be, wawuŋ hekeb Yesuya komatmiŋya gobe taun kuruŋ go tubul teŋ mulgaŋ heŋbe hinhande gor kwamiŋ.
Fik he torok yiriŋ
Be, wampot Yerusalem mulgaŋ heŋ kuŋ heŋyabe fik he goyen filginiŋde mat po torok yitiŋ kenamiŋ.
Keneŋbe Pita gobe biŋ bak yekeb, “Tisa, fik he karan uraŋ gob torok yiyuŋ iro kena,” inyiŋ.
Gwaha inkeb Yesu beleŋ wol heŋbe, “Dufaytiŋbe Al Kuruŋ niŋ po tareŋ irnayiŋ.

Fudinde wor po dineŋ hime. Al kura dugu gayen, ‘Kuŋ makaŋ alare kata!’ ineŋ biŋde dufay budam ma iryeŋ. Irdeb dufaymiŋde, ‘Mere tihim gabe forok yeŋ nunyeŋ,’ yeŋ nuryeŋ gobe gwahade po forok yeŋ unyeŋ.
Gwahade niŋgeb gago dinhem. Det kuraŋ Al Kuruŋ gusuŋaŋ irnayiŋ gob dufaytiŋdebe tihit wor po yeŋ nurnayiŋ. Irkeb dende hiyyeŋ.
Niŋgeb Al Kuruŋ mere irde heŋya kadtiŋ beleŋ buluŋ dirtiŋ goyen bitiŋ bak yekeb goyare po halde yuneŋ hinayiŋ. Irke gab Adotiŋ saŋiŋmiŋ kuruŋ wor po goreb dende wor halde dunyeŋ,” yinyiŋ.
Yesu tareŋmiŋ ge gusuŋaŋ iramiŋ

Be, Yesuya komatmiŋya goyen sopte kuŋ Yerusalem forok yamiŋ. Irdeb Yesu go Al Kuruŋyen ya balem goyen koya milgu irtiŋ bana hurkuŋ kuŋ waŋ teŋ hikeb pris buda gote karkuwaŋmiŋya Moseyen saba marya Yuda marte doyaŋ mar parguwakya beleŋ yeŋ hitte wayamiŋ.
Irdeb Yesu gusuŋaŋ irdeb, “Mata teŋ ha gayenbe ganuŋyen deŋemde teŋ ha? Ganuŋ beleŋ gwaha teŋ hayiŋ ginkeb gago teŋ ha?” inamiŋ.
Irkeb Yesu beleŋ wol heŋbe, “Ne wor gusuŋaŋ uŋkureŋ kura direŋ tihim goyen wol henaŋ ko. Irke gab al goyen deŋemde mata teŋ hime yeŋ momoŋ direŋ.
Yon Baptais beleŋ al baptais yirde hinhin goyenbe Al Kuruŋyen deŋemde ma alyen deŋemde? Momoŋ nirnaŋ!” yinyiŋ.
Irkeb mel go yiŋgeŋ uliŋ mere sege irdeb, “Al Kuruŋyen deŋemde intek gob, ‘Munaŋ daniŋ geb sabamiŋ goyen usi yeŋ nurde gama ma irde hinhan?’ dinyeŋ,” yamiŋ.
Munaŋ alyen deŋemde yetek gobe al buda kuruŋ gob Yon Baptaisbe Al Kuruŋyen mere basaŋ al fudinde wor po yeŋ nurde hinhan geb, goke kafura hamiŋ.
Niŋgeb mel goreb, “Neŋbe go ma nurde hite,” inamiŋ. Irkeb Yesu beleŋ, “Ne wor mata teŋ hime gayen al gote deŋemde teŋ hime ma dineŋ,” yinyiŋ.

footnotes.text: Hosanna gote miŋbe ‘Al Kuruŋ, ge po turuŋ girde hitek!’
Hora kapyaŋ heŋ heŋ marbe Roma gabmanyen horaya Yuda marte horaya goyen al beleŋ yeŋ yunke Al Kuruŋyen ya balemde niŋ hora teŋ wolmiŋeŋ al go yunke gab Al Kuruŋ galak yirde haŋyen.
-26 Asaŋ hoyaŋdebe gahade hi: 26 deŋ beleŋ kadtiŋ buluŋ dirtiŋ goyen ma halde yuneŋ bitiŋ bana po yerde hinayiŋbe Adotiŋ tareŋmiŋ kuruŋ wor po goreb mata buluŋtiŋ goyen ma halde dunyeŋ.
